title: Pick a voltage
brief: A voltage divider: put the pot's two end legs on + and −, and its middle leg (the wiper) becomes an adjustable voltage from 0 to 5 V.
Nothing connects to the wiper: it's an output. Power up, pick the Meter, put the red probe in the wiper's strip and the black probe on a − rail.
Turn the knob (its slider is in the parts bin) until the meter reads 3.3 V, the ESP32's logic level. Then press Check.
lesson: Vout = Vin × (the track below the wiper ÷ the whole track). The horn detector's threshold works the same way: R3 and RV1 divide 3.3 V down to a voltage you set with the trimmer.
